settings_about_description: LTK Manager is part of the LeagueToolkit project. It provides a graphical interface for managing League of Legends mods using the modpkg format.
settings_about_meta_wiki_description: Class and property documentation in the bin editor comes from the *LoL Meta Wiki*, under CC BY-SA 4.0.
settings_backup_confirm_description: The data location and the diagnostics identity stay. A path from the backup that does not exist on this machine is skipped.
settings_backup_description: Settings file to restore on this or another machine
settings_backup_error_io_title: The backup could not be read or written
settings_backup_error_newer_version_desc: Update LTK Manager, then restore it again.
settings_backup_error_newer_version_titl: A newer version of LTK Manager wrote this backup
settings_backup_error_not_a_backup_title: The file is not an LTK Manager settings backup
settings_backup_unchanged_title: The backup matches the current settings
settings_builtins_base_skins_description: Every skin of a champion in scope shows its base skin, a mod's where one replaces it.
settings_builtins_base_skins_hint: Only on your screen, for every player. A mod made for one skin keeps that skin. Every champion puts each champion archive in the overlay, about 16 GB, so the first patch after choosing it takes a while.
settings_builtins_description: Changes the manager applies to the game on its own, with no mod to install.
settings_builtins_forced_map_skin_descri: Shown on each map tagged beside it
settings_builtins_forced_map_skin_hint: Only skins whose map geometry and materials ship are listed. A skin can still fail to load, so try a new choice in the Practice Tool first.
settings_builtins_forced_map_skin_missin: {name} is not in this install, so games keep their own skin
settings_builtins_forced_map_skin_no_pat: Set the League path to list the map skins
settings_builtins_forced_map_skin_none_d: Nothing changes until a skin is chosen
settings_builtins_inking_camera_distance: The camera distance at which the outline has the chosen thickness. A higher value gives a thinner outline at every zoom level.
settings_builtins_inking_champions_descr: Each champion that gets an outline
settings_builtins_inking_champions_empty: No champions chosen, so no outline draws
settings_builtins_inking_champions_no_pa: Set the League path to list the champions
settings_builtins_inking_chosen_maps_emp: No maps chosen, so no outline draws
settings_builtins_inking_chosen_maps_no_: Set the League path to list the maps
settings_builtins_inking_color_team_hint: Allies use one color and enemies the other. Your champion counts as an ally.
settings_builtins_inking_death_fade_hint: How long the outline takes to fade out when a champion dies. The preview does not show it.
settings_builtins_inking_description: Draws an ink outline around champions, as in League Classic
settings_builtins_inking_hint: Only on your screen. Changes apply the next time the patcher starts. The preview shows them at once.
settings_builtins_inking_maps_hint: A map holds the outline, so it draws in every mode played on that map. TFT is never inked.
settings_builtins_inking_minions_descrip: Lane minions of Summoner's Rift and ARAM get an outline
settings_builtins_inking_preview_failed: The preview could not be written for this champion
settings_builtins_inking_preview_no_path: Set the League path to preview the outline
settings_builtins_inking_scope_all_hint: Inking every champion puts each champion archive in the overlay, about 16 GB, and the first patch after turning it on takes a while. Base skins on every champion uses the same archives, so the two share most of that cost.
settings_builtins_inking_structures_desc: Turrets, inhibitors and nexuses get an outline
settings_builtins_map_decorations_descri: Map pieces an event switches on, forced off or on in every game
settings_builtins_map_decorations_empty: No map in this install has decorations an event switches
settings_builtins_map_decorations_hint: Only on your screen. Hiding the Hall of Legends also removes the Tristana statue. The carved mid-lane ground on Summoner's Rift stays, since no event switches it. The overlay then holds its own copy of each map archive, several GB, and the first patch after hiding the Hall of Legends rewrites each Summoner's Rift map, so it takes a while.
settings_builtins_map_decorations_no_pat: Set the League path to list the map decorations
settings_builtins_map_skin_chosen_descri: Every game shows the skin chosen below
settings_builtins_map_skin_classic_descr: Event games show the normal map
settings_builtins_map_skin_game_descript: Games show the skin the server names
settings_builtins_map_skin_hint: Only on your screen. Changes the map's environment: geometry, grass, particles, minimap and color grading. Minions, turrets, music and the loading screen still follow the event. The overlay then holds its own copy of each map archive, several GB, so the first patch after choosing it takes a while.
settings_builtins_ward_skins_description: Every ward shows its base skin.
settings_builtins_ward_skins_hint: Only on your screen. The overlay then holds its own copy of each map archive, several GB, so the first patch after turning this on takes a while.
settings_data_adopt_description: The current data location holds no library, so nothing moves. LTK Manager restarts on the new folder.
settings_data_move_description: LTK Manager restarts when the move finishes.
settings_data_move_error_inside_data_des: Pick a folder outside the mods, profiles and cache folders.
settings_data_move_error_inside_data_tit: The new folder is inside the data that moves
settings_data_move_error_io_title: The data could not be moved
settings_data_move_error_no_space_descri: The move needs {needed} and the drive has {available} free.
settings_data_move_error_occupied_descri: It contains {entries}. Pick an empty folder.
settings_data_move_error_occupied_title: The new folder already holds LTK Manager data
settings_data_move_error_patcher_running: Stop the patcher, then move the data.
settings_data_move_error_same_folder_tit: That folder is the current data location
settings_disk_description: Space your data takes, and caches you can clear
settings_disk_load_failed_title: Could not measure the data folders
settings_disk_overlay_confirm_descriptio: The next patcher start rebuilds the overlay, which takes longer than a normal start.
settings_disk_overlay_confirm_heading: Clear the overlay builds of every profile?
settings_file_types_choose_hint: Windows keeps a program you picked yourself, so the default changes in Default apps.
settings_file_types_description: Options for opening mod files from Explorer
settings_file_types_register_description: Opening a .fantome or .modpkg file from Explorer installs it.
settings_file_types_register_title: Open mod files with LTK Manager
settings_file_types_unassigned_label: Windows asks which program to use
settings_integrations_classic_hint: On Windows 11, classic entries appear under Show more options.
settings_integrations_cleanup_descriptio: Some files are still in use or referenced by Explorer. Close the tool or remove its external context menu, then retry Uninstall to finish cleanup.
settings_integrations_error_conflict_des: Enable the context menu again to review replacement, or leave the other installation in control.
settings_integrations_error_integrity_de: Retry the download. No unverified executable will be installed.
settings_integrations_error_receipt_desc: Keep the installation files and report this error before changing the installation record.
settings_integrations_handler_descriptio: Manage this administrator-installed bundle with Tex Tools. It cannot be changed from Manager yet. Existing handlers are preserved.
settings_integrations_install_descriptio: Installs a verified release for this user with the selected Explorer options. PATH and texture handlers remain unchanged.
settings_integrations_release_descriptio: Release information could not be checked. Local installation status is still available.
settings_integrations_repair_description: Some installation files are missing or a previous operation was interrupted. Repair restores the installed release.
settings_integrations_replace_descriptio: The context menus point to another installation or have changed. Replace them with this managed installation and keep a backup for removal?
settings_integrations_uninstall_descript: Removes the managed executable files and restores the context menus this installation replaced. Configuration, outputs and texture handlers are preserved.
settings_integrations_unsupported_descri: Managed installation is available on Windows x64.
settings_library_categorization_descript: Champions, maps and tags get read from each mod's files.
settings_library_categorization_hint: They are offered as suggested categories and as library filters. Turn this off to rely only on the categories you set yourself.
settings_library_health_check_descriptio: Mods get checked for problems at startup, after a hashtable sync and after an install.
settings_library_health_check_hint: Turn this off to check mods only when you start a check yourself.
settings_library_promotion_description: Enabled mods move to the front of their folder in the load order.
settings_library_storage_description: Folder for your mods, overlay builds and caches. A change moves them there.
settings_library_trusted_domains_descrip: One-click links only install from these domains. Remove all of them to allow any source.
settings_library_watcher_description: Mods added or removed outside the app show up in the library.
settings_library_watcher_hint: Filesystem notifications vary across platforms and antivirus software, so watching can miss an update or fire falsely. Requires a restart to take effect.
settings_updates_auto_download_descripti: A new version downloads in the background and installs when you quit LTK Manager. When off, it downloads only when you press Update Now.
settings_viewport_sound_description: Sound events play in the skin, VFX and ability previews.
settings_viewport_sound_hint: The mix is an approximation of the game's, without buses, RTPCs, attenuation or 3D position.
settings_viewport_sound_volume_descripti: Applies to the sound of every viewport.
settings_welcome_description: To get started, please configure your League of Legends installation path below. You can use auto-detection or browse to the folder manually.
settings_wwise_console_description: A .wav, .ogg or .flac converts to a Vorbis WEM through WwiseConsole.exe when it replaces media.
